Ana (Growth): Drafting the benchmark narrative for next week's launch — focus on throughput-to-cost tradeoffs, real app examples, and a tight 2-chart hero.
Mike P: Love that. Can we keep the hero chart as tokens/sec vs $/k tokens? Super simple for sales and devs.
Drew (Prod): Also add a micro panel for tail latency (p95/p99) — a lot of folks care about worst-case.
Sarah - Content: Wording thought: 'Same model, different serving choices: decide for latency or for cost.' Softer than 'pick'.
Ana (Growth): Draft hero claim: '30% lower p95 at comparable unit cost' — do we have the data to support?
Mike P: We do for the M70X-equivalent run — our optimized runtime shows ~28% lower p95 vs baseline on the production traffic mix. I'll pull the CSV.
Drew (Prod): Note — those numbers depend on batching and KV-cache settings. We should include the exact config in the appendix.
Mike P: Quick config snippet for appendix: ```json
{"batch_max_tokens":512,"max_concurrency":8,"kv_cache":true}
```
Sarah - Content: For the webinar, propose 3 hooks: 1) Live demo of latency under load, 2) Case study: rerank cost delta for search, 3) Short Q&A on rollouts and fallbacks.
Ana (Growth): Inbound flow idea: sign-up -> small benchmark kit (sample prompt + script) -> solutions follow-up for >$5k MRC prospects.
Sarah - Content: CTA copy options: 'See your tokens per dollar in 2 minutes' or 'Estimate your inference cost in 2 mins' — which is punchier?
Mike P: 'See your tokens per dollar in 2 minutes' is clearer. I'll add a short spreadsheet export for customers.
Olm-bot: Reminder: webinar page draft is live at https://redwood.example/webinar (design staging).
Mike P: For the hero slide — left chart: tokens/sec, right chart: tokens/$. Use same traffic profile annotation on both so audience understands tradeoffs.
Sarah - Content: I'll draft slide copy and two email variants for A/B: concise value-first vs technical deep-dive.
Drew (Prod): I can supply p95/p99 and tail histograms for the three sample workloads (chat, assistant, rerank).
Ana (Growth): OK action list: Mike = metrics + CSV + spreadsheet export; Drew = config + p95/p99 + histograms; Sarah = slides, CTAs, email variants; Design = slide comps. Target: EOD Thu for rehearsal run.
Sarah - Content: +1 on EOD Thu. I'll also prep the 2 landing CTAs and small evaluation kit link.
Mike P: Sending CSV to #marketing-assets in 10.
Ana (Growth): Perfect — thanks everyone. We'll keep the hero concise and the appendix nerdy. :rocket:
